finding: The trainer loads the NPZ energy member for all roles, checks all values finite, computes observations/bin labels for all splits and writes observed_rows_outside_training_bin_support by split, including TEST. TRAIN minibatches and weighted training losses use TRAIN indices; checkpoint objective/selection uses VAL indices; no TEST model-loss calculation is made. The TEST support aggregate was not used by the integrating owner for model/representation/iteration selection.
interpretation: Do not claim TEST energy values were never materialized or that no TEST-derived aggregate was produced. Original H0 TEST weights, labels, identities and assignments remain unchanged. Newly developed follow-up restricts derived conditions and support statistics to TRAIN/VAL while noting NPZ decompression still materializes the energy member.
scope: This does not affect existing held-out historical FINAL values or make them suitable for selection; earlier separate historical-row exposure remains disclosed.
